verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents Scheduled Flags, which queue flag changes and apply them automatically at a specified future time. This is the core of the story. Release Pipelines add automated, staged progression of releases, and the Admin API mirrors dashboard actions, so scheduling plausibly works programmatically. Missing for 10: detail on scheduling releases/pipeline stages by time (vs. triggers), explicit API/CLI scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
